title: Existence of normalized self-Tor comparison
statement: For every commutative ring A, ideal I and natural number n, there exists an A-linear morphism from the exterior conormal module [new-r4-conormal-exterior-module] to Tor_n^A(A/I,A/I) satisfying [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-predicate]. No regularity hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09PQ, strictly graded commutative Tor; Tag 00LS, comparison of free complexes with resolutions

proof.text: Resolve the quotient by a Tate free strictly commutative dg algebra. The quotient boundary identifies degree-one Tor classes with I/I². Products of n such classes are alternating and A/I-multilinear, including in characteristic two; apply the exterior universal property.

A Koszul augmentation lift to a projective resolution computes the same product. Two chain lifts are homotopic because the Koszul terms are projective and the resolution is exact in positive degrees. Thus the displayed normalization holds for every lift and every wedge.
